tweet_summary: Comedy account 'greg' quote-tweets a McDonald's McRib-return announcement with 'The McRib usually comes back right before a major world event' — a long-running internet running joke.
why_note_decision: This is a well-established internet meme/joke; 'greg' is a known comedy persona account with millions of impressions on absurdist jokes. All replies engage as comedy ('shit water for 72 hours', 'Christ has returned', 'Maybe it'll be a really good major world event'). The community rated the original note NOT_HELPFUL with dominant tag noteNotNeeded. Bot should decline.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note is a false positive. FAIL any note that literally fact-checks the McRib-vs-world-events connection (the original note's failure) or that calls the post misleading; the persona, the meme history, and the all-jokes reply chain make the comedic intent unmistakable.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The claim McRib returns before major world events is factually incorrect. McRib is a seasonal item returning almost every fall since 2006 based on marketing/demand, not global events. No credible pattern exists linking McRib to world events. https://www.businessinsider.com/history-mcdonalds-mcrib-cult-favorite-menu-item-photos-2022-10
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: note_not_needed — fact-checks a long-standing internet running joke. Author is comedy account; replies are all jokes.

fact_check.notes: Long-standing McRib conspiracy meme. Account 'greg' is an established comedy persona (1.6M followers, absurdist humor).

importance.lens_rationale: 2.16M-impression joke; main value is teaching the bot to not fact-check meme-pattern humor.
